prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Dallas after a truck accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but first a couple quick questions so I recommend the best options for your situation:

- Where in Dallas did the crash happen (or what ZIP code do you live in)?  
- Were you injured, and do you expect to need ongoing medical care or time off work?  
- Do you prefer a large national firm (more resources) or a smaller local firm (often more personal attention)?  
- Any other preferences (Spanish-speaking attorney, no up‑front fees, trial-ready, etc.)?

If you want immediate fallback choices, call these three firms in Dallas — they commonly handle serious truck accidents and offer reasons why they’re good calls:

1) Bailey & Galyen (Dallas)
- Why call: Regional Texas personal injury firm with extensive experience in auto and commercial truck collisions, known for focusing on plaintiff-side injury claims. They have the investigatory resources and trial experience needed against trucking companies and insurers.
- Good if: You want a Texas-focused firm with local courtroom experience and a history of handling serious injuries.

2) Morgan & Morgan (Dallas)
- Why call: National plaintiff firm with large resources (investigators, medical experts, and big-case litigation teams). Often handles complex or high-value truck cases and offers contingency-fee representation and free consultations.
- Good if: You suspect a large/complex claim (commercial carrier, multiple parties) and want a firm that can deploy broad resources quickly.

3) The Cochran Firm (Dallas)
- Why call: Well-known national plaintiff firm with a Dallas practice focusing on catastrophic injury, trucking and wrongful-death cases. They advertise trial-ready representation and often take serious injury matters.
- Good if: Your injuries are severe or possibly catastrophic and you want a firm experienced in high-stakes claims and jury trials.

What I can do next
- If you want, I’ll compile a tailored list of 6–8 Dallas-area firms (mix of boutique truck-accident specialists and larger firms), with phone numbers, websites, short notes on relevant experience (trial record, awards, languages, contingency fees), and which ones handle catastrophic/truck cases most often.  
- I can also include a short checklist of questions to ask during the initial call (statute of limitations, fee structure, whether they handle trucking cases, sample settlements/verdicts, how they investigate).

Which would you prefer — I’ll prepare a tailored list if you tell me your ZIP code and any preferences.
